svg.text: Silhouette test: the three Anti-hero concepts and a bystander, flat black at true size

View at 100% zoom. Sizes are body height (feet to hair). Left block: flat black. Middle: the same figure in colour over day sky and sea. Right: find the fighter among bystanders. Status: results pending Legal review.
Find the fighter (5 px, then 12 px)
pole above the head, plate stack
Slots (5 px, 12 px): A 4th, 8th. B 9th, 3rd. C 6th, 11th.
